podcast.title: Breakup for Pink's Solo Career
podcast.body: By 1998, L.A. Reed gave Pink an ultimatum: "Go Solo or Go Home." Pink chose the former, leading to the breakup of Choice and the permanent shelving of their unreleased album. "So by 1998, Reed had given Pink and ultimatum, Go Solo or Go Home."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: One Single on Kazaam Soundtrack
podcast.body: Choice's one and only single was issued on the 1996 soundtrack to the family film "Kazaam," starring basketball player Shaquille O'Neal. This was the only official release by the group before their eventual breakup. "And issued their one and only single on the 1996 soundtrack to the family film, Kazam."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Signing to LaFace Records
podcast.body: In 1995, the teen trio Choice, including Pink, was flown to Atlanta, Georgia, to meet with L.A. Reed, president of LaFace Records, on the strength of their song "Key to My Heart." Reed signed Choice, with the trio's parents co-signing the contract. "On the strength of the song, in 1995, the girl group was flown to Atlanta, Georgia, for a meeting with the man we discussed in our outcast episode of Hip-Head Philly. L.A. Reed, the producer turned president of LaFace Records."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
